title: statespace shared definitions, version 1
description: Definitions shared by the record schemas. A record schema refers to them as urn:statespace:defs@1#/$defs/<name>. Patterns use only the constructs that ECMAScript and Python read alike (see schemas/README.md): [0-9] never \d, and (?![\s\S]) for the end of the input, never $.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

statementSha256.description: The hash of a pinned statement (a Lean challenge, a TLA+ property, an SMT-LIB file or a YAML claim file): SHA-256 over the text with trailing whitespace removed plus one newline, the rule of Comparator Live's challenge hash, sha256(challenge.trimRight() + "\n"). The x-statementHash annotation is the one written specification; the TypeScript and Python implementations are generated from it and tested against schemas/vectors/statement-hash.json.

steps: Read the statement file as bytes. Do not translate line endings.
Decode the bytes as UTF-8, strictly: invalid UTF-8 is an error, never a replacement character. Keep a leading U+FEFF.
Remove from the end of the text every code point listed in trimRight, repeatedly, until the last code point is not listed. Nothing is removed from the start or the middle.
Take the SHA-256 of those bytes and write it as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

trimRight.basis: ECMAScript WhiteSpace and LineTerminator (ECMA-262 sections 12.2 and 12.3): the code points that String.prototype.trimEnd, also named trimRight, removes. WhiteSpace is U+0009, U+000B, U+000C, U+FEFF and every code point of general category Zs; LineTerminator is U+000A, U+000D, U+2028 and U+2029. Python's str.rstrip() removes a different set, so no implementation may use it.

instant.description: A point in time as RFC 3339 date-time, in uppercase, with a Z or a numeric UTC offset and no leap second. The calendar is not checked (a day of 31 passes in every month).

localDate.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. The calendar is not checked.

repoPath.description: A relative POSIX path inside a repository: segments of letters, digits and . _ @ + = , - joined by single slashes, with no leading or trailing slash, no empty segment, and no segment that is . or ..

localId.description: A learner-chosen identifier, at most 64 characters: letters and digits, then letters, digits and . _ -

prose.description: Free text written by a person: a non-empty string.

labStageId.description: A lab stage, such as LAB-2.2.

checkId.description: A lab check, such as LAB-2.c7.

claimTemplateId.description: A claim template, such as CL-2.1.

engineAtVersion.description: An engine and the version that ran, as name@version, such as z3@5.3.1. The version is recorded verbatim.

misconceptionKey.description: A misconception key of the catalog in docs/EVIDENCE.md section 6, such as dp:G4.
